title: message.requested payload
description: Payload for `{service}.message.requested`, consumed by AbeonUnified (ADR-0030). A transactional message: an invitation, a password reset, an address verification. It is not a notification — it ignores channel preferences and its recipient may have no account. Delivery is idempotent on `idempotency_key`.

user_id.description: Set when the recipient already has an account.

data.description: Variables the template renders. Never a password.

idempotency_key.description: From the business fact that caused the message (`auth.invitation:1842`), never random — a redelivered event must not send a second mail.
